records.text: Explain how plants use sunlight to make food through photosynthesis.
records.answer: Plants use light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into sugars, releasing oxygen.

records.text: Describe photosynthesis: how green plants turn sunlight into food.
records.answer: Chlorophyll absorbs light; carbon dioxide and water are used to produce sugars and oxygen.

records.text: Explain how water evaporates from liquid into water vapor.
records.answer: Water molecules gain enough energy to leave the liquid surface and enter the gas phase.

records.text: Describe evaporation, when liquid water becomes a gas.
records.answer: At the surface, energetic molecules escape from liquid water as vapor.
